caption: Matmenys
notes: Not a wall-thickness matrix: one row per profile, every cell filled. The header strip has two text lines and no table-wide caption: line 1 = "Žymėjimas", "Teorinis metro svoris (kg/m)" and the group header "Matmenys"; line 2 = the sub-labels "h", "b", "s", "t", "r", "r₂", which all belong to the group "Matmenys" (no unit is printed for them; mm by context). "Matmenys" is put in "caption" only because it is the text printed above the labels h/b/s/t/r/r₂ - it is a group header for the dimension columns and does not span the first two columns. The last label is the letter r with a small subscript 2; it is written here with the Unicode subscript character U+2082 ("r₂", i.e. r2). Column assignment checked by x-position (header label x / body value x, px): 1/2, 189/190, h 440/440, b 541/541, s 642/642, t 742/743, r 844/844, r2 945/945. Row UPN 380, column s: printed with a comma ("13,5") - the only comma in the table - stored as "13.5". Dimension values are printed without trailing zeros (5, 7, 10, 8.75), weights with three significant digits (5.59, 10.6, 16.0). Columns t and r carry identical values in every row, exactly as printed. Row UPN 65: the weight is clearly printed 7.04; the commonly published value for UPN 65 is 7.09 kg/m (that figure is from memory, not from the image), so this may be a typo in the source image - transcribed as printed, NOT corrected. Body has no grid lines and no zebra striping; the row background colour is a stock code explained by the legend printed under the table: darker blue = "Laikoma sandėlyje" (rows UPN 50 - UPN 300, 14 rows), light grey-blue = "Tiekiama pagal užsakymą" (rows UPN 320 - UPN 400, 4 rows). Source is a JPEG, but the bitmap-font digits survive intact: every digit matched its template exactly at five different binarisation thresholds (0 mismatches in 144 cells), and all rows were re-read visually at 2x and 6x.
